sql_calls.sql:
SELECT tender, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(amount_inr) as total_amount
FROM payments.pos_payments
GROUP BY tender
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT p.tender, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) as bills,
       COUNT(*) as attempts,
       AVG(p.amount_inr) as avg_amount,
       MIN(p.amount_inr) as min_amount,
       MAX(p.amount_inr) as max_amount
FROM payments.pos_payments p
WHERE p.till_status = 'approved'
GROUP BY p.tender
ORDER BY bills DESC;

SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.pack, p.flow, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr,
       SUM(pl.qty) as total_units_sold,
       SUM(pl.line_amount) as total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) as bills_count
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.pos_lines pl ON p.gtin = pl.gtin_scanned
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.pack, p.flow, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;
